name: Fujichrome Provia 400X
source: Fuji Photo Film Co., Ltd., FUJICHROME PROVIA 400X Professional [RXP] Product Information Bulletin, Ref. No. AF3-0213E (2006-01), page 7

notes.characteristic: Exposure daylight 1/50 s, process E-6/CR-56, densitometry Fuji FAD-30S (Status A).
notes.sensitivity: Process E-6/CR-56, densitometry Fuji FAD-30S (Status A), density 1.0 above D-min, sensitivity = 1/exposure (J/cm2); log axis drawn 0 to 3 rather than relative.
notes.dye_density: Spectral diffuse density of each dye, exposure separated, process E-6/CR-56; normalized to a peak of 1.0, no viewing illuminant stated.

grain.note: Diffuse RMS granularity, micro-densitometer aperture 48 um diameter, sample density +1.0 (Fujifilm measurement).
